description:
Kernels can't read module attributes today (`x + @lim` fails with 'undefined variable lim'). Allow integer and float module attributes, inlined at compile time as literals; any other attribute value is a compile error in the kernel compile error format. Needed by PCM (@s16_max/@s16_min) and Gorilla (@mask64; masked arithmetic in defk-wlu already assumes `band(expr, @mask64)`).

Each accepted convenience construct needs: an Elixir-mode meaning, agreement tests (Defk.Case, both modes), and a docs/language.md entry. Decided in 'Which convenience constructs do the six target workloads need?' (defk-dtw.18); sketches on branch prototype/defk-dtw.18-sketches (prototypes/convenience_sketches.exs).

Done when @attr works in any expression position including band masks and case/guard literals, both modes agree, and language.md lists the allowed value types.
title: Module attributes as constants in kernels
